synaxis:client-mod-required: This server needs the Synaxis client mod. Install the modpack and join again.
synaxis:protocol-version-mismatch: This mod speaks a different protocol than the server. Update the modpack.
synaxis:match-unavailable: The match has ended. Back to the main menu.
synaxis:game-flood: The server saw too many game messages from this connection. Reconnect; if it keeps happening, report it with the connection id from the server log.
synaxis:protocol-error: The server rejected a message from this connection as malformed.
synaxis:unsupported-version: This Minecraft version cannot talk to the server.
synaxis:duplicate-login: Somebody is already playing under this name.
synaxis:internal-error: The server failed to bring you into the world.
synaxis:server-stopping-in: The server shuts down in %s seconds.
synaxis:too-many-connections: Too many connections from your network. If this keeps happening, report it to the server admins.
synaxis:login-throttled: Logging in too often. Wait a few seconds and try again.
synaxis:auth-failed: This server only accepts genuine Minecraft accounts. Log in with the official launcher and join again.
synaxis:auth-unavailable: The Minecraft account service cannot be reached right now. Try again in a moment.
synaxis:logged-in-elsewhere: Your account logged in from another place.
synaxis:state-unavailable: Your character could not be loaded. Try again in 30 seconds.
synaxis:transfer-rejected: Switching regions failed. Please log in again.
synaxis:transfer-failed: The transfer failed. Please try again later.
synaxis:role-no-target: No player online here is called %s, and it is not a UUID.
synaxis:role-unavailable: Roles cannot be reached right now. Try again in a moment.
synaxis:command-no-player: No player online here is called %s.
synaxis:command-stop-usage: Usage: stop [seconds], a whole number from 0.
synaxis:command-tps: TPS %s, MSPT p50 %s ms, p95 %s ms, p99 %s ms over the last %s ticks.
synaxis.order.busy: The server is busy; try again.
